title: Classical music by work and performance
description: One work across different recordings, with the differences between them made clear.

blocks.text: An album title does not always help find the movement or the performer you need. A classical listener looks for connections that an ordinary catalog shows scattered.

quote.text: After using both Apple Classical and IDAGIO, IDAGIO is the clear winner. Navigation is more intuitive, searching for a specific work is faster, and the discovery features actually surface music worth hearing.

blocks.text: Link the work, its movements, the performers and the recordings available. Save the version chosen to a personal collection.
The catalog and playback require supported sources and access terms. A matching title has to be checked against the recording, the performers and the edition.
